description: Payload errors of a DecryptedTransaction as the ring rpc serializes them. kinds names every OutputPayloadErrorKind. unknown_asset_bad_pair_hint holds the errors of one anonymous slot whose opened note names a mint the asset registry lacks. Its pair hint names no contributory X25519 key, and the Rust audit reports both errors for the slot. Pinned by the custom-rings/client rpc tests and decoded by the TypeScript RingRpc tests.
